headline: Liverpool sign Djylian N'Guessan, 18, for next season

headline: Igor Jesus targeting Champions League football, unsure if future is at Nottingham Forest
description: Nottingham Forest forward Igor Jesus has set his sights on playing Champions League football in the future, and said he does not know whether he will fulfil that ambition at the City Ground or elsewhere.

headline: Man City's busy summer: How Maresca & Co. navigated Rodri exit, rebuilding midfield
description: Man City and coach Enzo Maresca were caught by surprise with Rodri's decision to leave this summer, and that exit was the highlight of a busy window in which not everything went their way.
